input.command:
# Pretty-fix the jammed keys in non-en/fr locales
$files = @('ar','cn','de','el','es','he','in','it','jp','ru')
foreach ($lang in $files) {
  $path = "c:\Dev\PATTOOL2\PatTool_Front-End\src\assets\i18n\$lang.json"
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path)
  $text = $text -replace '"CAL_MODAL_TITLE": "North calibration","CAL_CHOOSE"', "`"CAL_MODAL_TITLE`": `"North calibration`",`r`n    `"CAL_CHOOSE`""
  $text = $text -replace '"CAL_MOUSE_HINT_BAR": "Place N on the dial, then confirm","CAL_DONE_MOUSE"', "`"CAL_MOUSE_HINT_BAR`": `"Place N on the dial, then confirm`",`r`n    `"CAL_DONE_MOUSE`""
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $text)
  Write-Output "fixed $lang"
}
input.description: Fix jammed i18n key line breaks
